name_en: Hurt, and four bottles with no names
trap: Four bottles stand in a row on a brick bench in a low nook; one heals (a full bottle of the healing potion restores all 100 HP), the other three hold toxic sludge, a fuel (oil or whiskey) and one more plain liquid; none is better marked than the others. Drinking a mouthful of an unknown bottle at low HP is a gamble: sludge poisons (2 % of max HP a second, about 13 s after 40 frames of drinking, never lethal), whiskey makes the aim shake, oil makes the drinker flammable
cue: The bottles are only shapes on the map; inspect names what each holds, and so does a small pour; the nook lies in the caves where fire and gunpowder hurt, so the player arrives hurt more often than not
notes: Inspect each bottle (free, no time passes), then drink the potion; or pour a few cells of each on the floor to see what it is. The scorer reads HP on entry to the nook, whether a bottle was inspected before the first drink, and the order and amount drunk.

lessons.note: The bottle nearest the door is always toxic sludge, never the healing potion
Drinking oil covers you in oil, so you catch fire easily
Drinking whiskey makes you drunk and your aim shakes

nearest_bottle_to_door.about: in the row of four unlabelled bottles on the brick bench, what the bottle nearest the door holds
